plan: Moved token loading and Bot(token=...) construction inside the try/except in main() so unreadable .env/config.json files and malformed or stale tokens print the friendly error message instead of raising a raw traceback. Session cleanup in the finally block now only runs when the bot was constructed successfully, since a construction failure returns before the close block. Added two focused unittest cases: one monkeypatching Bot to raise ValueError and asserting main() prints the friendly error, and one simulating PermissionError on .env read.
